caption: The drawing depicts a single metal teapot or coffee pot centered within a square frame on a plain background. The pot has a cylindrical body with a slightly flared base featuring two horizontal rings. It has a domed lid with a small finial on top, and a tall, curved spout extending from the upper left side. The handle, situated on the right, is large, ornate, and has a bulbous end with additional curves and a thumb rest at the top. The object is rendered in shades of gray, displaying highlights and shadows that suggest a metallic surface. The overall drawing is monochromatic, appearing to be created with graphite or pencil on beige or off-white paper. The artist's signature, "Eugene J. Darvill," appears at the lower right corner within the square frame.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
